title: Todos with due dates and an overdue view
statement: People use the todo service to track small tasks, but nothing tells them when a task is late. Add an optional due date to a todo, let the API list what is overdue, and make it obvious in the response when a task is past due. Keep the API backwards compatible: existing clients that never send a due date must keep working unchanged.

success_metrics.baseline: No way to tell a late task from an open one
success_metrics.target: GET /todos/overdue returns exactly the open todos whose due date is in the past, and each todo in any listing carries an overdue flag

success_metrics.baseline: Current clients create todos with only a title
success_metrics.target: Every existing test still passes unchanged; a todo without a due date is never overdue
success_metrics.measurement: The existing test suite plus new tests

must_not: Do not add a database; storage stays in memory
Do not change the shape of existing fields on a todo
Do not add new dependencies beyond the standard library and what is already in pyproject
